description: This file provides database service functions for managing device documents in a MongoDB collection, including connection handling, collection initialization with schema validation and indexes, and CRUD operations for device data.

methods.name: MongoClient _get_client()
methods.description: Initializes and returns a singleton MongoClient instance.

methods.name: Collection get_collection()
methods.description: Retrieves the MongoDB collection, creating it with validation and indexes if necessary.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _normalize_dates(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts the 'last_ping_time' field from ISO string to datetime object, if applicable.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _serialize_device(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Serializes a MongoDB document into a JSON-friendly dictionary, converting ObjectId and datetime fields.

methods.name: ObjectId _parse_object_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a string into a valid ObjectId, raising ValueError if invalid.

methods.name: str insert_device(device: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a new device document into the collection and returns its ID as a string.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] find_devices( filter_query: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, sort: Optional[List[Tuple[str, int]]] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, skip: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Finds devices matching a filter with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] update_device( filter_query: Dict[str, Any], update_doc: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Updates multiple devices matching a filter with a specified update document.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] delete_device(filter_query: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Deletes devices matching a filter and returns the count.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a device document by its ObjectId string.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] replace_one_by_id(id_str: str, new_doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Replaces a device document by its ObjectId, returning the updated document.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_one_by_id(id_str: str, partial: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a partial update of a device by its ObjectId, returning the updated document.

methods.name: bool delete_one_by_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Deletes a device by its ObjectId and returns whether the deletion was successful.

ctags.name: find_devices
ctags.signature: ( filter_query: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, sort: Optional[List[Tuple[str, int]]] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, skip: Optional[int] = None, )

ctags.name: replace_one_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^def replace_one_by_id(id_str: str, new_doc: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_device
ctags.signature: ( filter_query: Dict[str, Any], update_doc: Dict[str, Any], )

ctags.name: update_one_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^def update_one_by_id(id_str: str, partial: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
